_comment: Durchspiel-Faelle fuer scripts/conversation_test.ps1 (Orchestrator-Eingang, mehrere Runden, Aufzeichnung statt Bewertung). Format im Skript-Kopf. Nur Fixture-Personen. S1-S4: erste freie Saetze, Rat ohne Plan-Knopf, frisches Mitglied, Lebenszeichen, Rat ohne Geldkonto.

name: S1 Owner frisch fertig: erste freie Saetze
S2 Owner will Rat ohne Plan-Knopf: Berater-Gespraech mit Laien-Antworten
S3 Mitglied frisch bestaetigt: erste Fragen
S4 Lebenszeichen: Owner fertig, kurze Tests
S5 Owner ohne Geldkonto: Berater fragt zuerst nach dem Konto, legt es per Karte an

turns.text: Mein Geld liegt auf dem Girokonto __E2E__ Ahornbank Giro, da sind gerade 1.200 Euro drauf.
Das Gehalt sind 3000 netto, das kommt am 1.

name: S6 Ersteinrichtung: Haushalt, Konto, erste Buchung, Monats-Check, Plan-Start
notes: Gesamtablauf nach der Installation, bezahlt gedacht (conversation_test -Real). Alle Karten werden bestaetigt (Fall-Vorgabe approve): das Ergebnis nach der Bestaetigung ist pruefbar, darum stehen DB-Pruefungen und Rubrics mit Ergebnis-Aussagen. Die Runden sind Ketten (stop_on_fail): ohne Haushalt-Abschluss (Runde 4) sperrt das Core-first-Gate die Finanz-Agenten, ohne Konto (Runde 6) fehlt der Boden fuer die Folgerunden, und ohne uebersprungene oder erledigte Bereiche Depot/Kredite/Versicherungen/Sparziele (Runde 10) lehnt der Berater ab (Eingangs-Gate, Befund: wer nach den Konten gleich Rat will, wird auf /onboarding verwiesen). Kontoauszug-Fixture ist statisch auf Maerz 2000 datiert (tests/mock_telegram/make_doc_fixtures.ps1: IBAN, Anfangssaldo 500, Endsaldo 2012,60), darum liegen Eroeffnungsdatum und Buchung in dieser Zeit. Der Monats-Check erkennt die von Hand gebuchte Buchladen-Zahlung als schon erfasst (fn_statement_match Stufe 0 Handbuchung): kein unerklaerter Rest, keine Dublette; er bucht die Differenz (1.550 EUR = Gehalt minus Miete) als eine Abgleichsbuchung, Endsaldo 2.012,60 (gegen die echten fn_* geprueft). Konto traegt __E2E__ im Namen (Cleanup), Stand am Ende: Reset + Fixture-Seed.

turns.expected_behavior: The guide opens the household setup in German. The owner already exists in the household (Household so far): it must NOT ask again for the owner's name or birth date, but may confirm them briefly and asks only for what is missing (further household members, employment). One step at a time, no list of all sections, no booking or finance question, no invented data. Judge ONLY the agent's own text: a menu or button such as 'Weiter: <area>' that the system adds after the reply is not the agent's text and is allowed.

turns.text: Wir sind nur zu zweit im Haushalt und ich bin angestellt. Weitere Personen trage ich später ein.
turns.expected_behavior: The guide takes the answer without asking for anything it already knows. It either stores the fact (the user may be shown a confirmation card, which is confirmed in this test) or asks at most ONE short follow-up. It does not push for details the user said to add later and does not ask about finance topics yet. An optional offer to add details later (for example 'if you like, send me the partner's name and I add them') is NOT a question and is fine. Judge ONLY the agent's own text: the onboarding menu and its 'Weiter: <area>' button come from the system, not from the agent, and are allowed.

turns.text: Ja, das passt so. Der Haushalt ist damit fertig.

expect_sql.sql: SELECT status FROM agent.guide_onboarding_state WHERE section_key = 'household';

turns.expected_behavior: The household area is marked as done and the reply says so in a friendly short sentence. It may name the next area once and ask once whether the user wants to continue with it now: a pointer plus that one question is fine. It must not name several areas, list commands or topics, or start the next area on its own. Judge ONLY the agent's own text: the onboarding menu and its 'Weiter: <area>' button are added by the system after the reply (a deterministic next-step message) and do not count as a second pointer or as a topic list.

The bookkeeper starts the accounts area: it asks which accounts there are, one step at a time, and may mention that a statement photo or PDF works as well. It does not invent accounts, does not book anything and does not talk about areas other than accounts.

turns.text: Mein Girokonto ist das __E2E__ Erlenbank Giro bei der Erlenbank, IBAN DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00, Inhaberin ich. Am 29.02.2000 waren 500 Euro drauf.

expect_sql.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM finance.accounts WHERE name = '__E2E__ Erlenbank Giro' AND replace(account_number, ' ', '') = 'DE89370400440532013000';
SELECT b.balance FROM finance.account_balances b JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = b.account_id WHERE a.name = '__E2E__ Erlenbank Giro';

turns.expected_behavior: After the confirmed card the reply states that the account __E2E__ Erlenbank Giro is created with a balance of 500 EUR. It does not claim a different bank, IBAN or amount, does not ask for confirmation again and does not create further accounts.

expect_sql.sql: SELECT status FROM finance.onboarding_state WHERE section_key = 'accounts';

turns.expected_behavior: The accounts area is marked as done and the reply says so briefly. It may name the next area once and ask once whether the user wants to continue with it now: a proposal with a question is NOT pressure. Pressure would be starting the next area without the user's consent (asking about investment details, booking or reading anything for it) or asking again and again in the same reply.

turns.text: Buche bitte am 17.03.2000 eine Ausgabe von 37,40 Euro für Buchladen Test auf das __E2E__ Erlenbank Giro.

expect_sql.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id WHERE a.name = '__E2E__ Erlenbank Giro' AND t.amount = -37.40 AND t.transaction_date = DATE '2000-03-17';
SELECT b.balance FROM finance.account_balances b JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = b.account_id WHERE a.name = '__E2E__ Erlenbank Giro';

turns.expected_behavior: After the confirmed card the reply confirms the booking of 37,40 EUR (Buchladen Test, 17.03.2000) on __E2E__ Erlenbank Giro and names the new balance 462,60 EUR. It does not ask again for confirmation and does not book anything else.

turns.caption: Hier ist mein Kontoauszug März von der Erlenbank, bitte gleiche ihn ab.

expect_sql.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM finance.bank_statements s JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = s.account_id WHERE a.name = '__E2E__ Erlenbank Giro' AND s.period_end = DATE '2000-03-31';
SELECT b.balance FROM finance.account_balances b JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = b.account_id WHERE a.name = '__E2E__ Erlenbank Giro';

turns.expected_behavior: After the confirmed card the reply reports the monthly check of the statement in plain words: the statement was read, the difference to the app was booked as one adjustment, and the balance now matches the statement (2.012,60 EUR). It names the account __E2E__ Erlenbank Giro, may say that the manually booked Buchladen purchase (37,40 EUR) was already recorded, does not call it a possible duplicate or an unexplained difference, does not claim a different balance, and does not ask the user to export the file again.

turns.text: Depots, Kredite, Versicherungen, Vorsorge und Sparziele überspringe ich erst einmal.

expect_sql.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM finance.onboarding_state WHERE section_key IN ('investments', 'liabilities', 'protection', 'goals') AND status IN ('skipped', 'completed');

turns.expected_behavior: The bookkeeper accepts the skip without pushing back and marks the open finance areas as skipped (depot and savings plans, loans and regular payments, insurances and pensions, savings goals). It says briefly that the user can come back to them at any time and may say that advice is possible now. It does not ask questions about the skipped topics and does not book anything.

The advisor starts the planning conversation without asking for a topic first. It asks only ONE thing at a time in plain language, does not ask for the account or balance it already sees in the data, and does not book anything. It names only the ONE missing item it asks about now (e.g. the regular net income): announcing further missing items in the same message (e.g. 'two basics are still missing: income and the largest expense') is a FAIL, even when only one question follows.

turns.text: Das Gehalt sind 2.400 netto, das kommt am Monatsletzten aufs Erlenbank Giro.
turns.expected_behavior: After the confirmed card the reply says the salary of 2.400 EUR (end of month, Erlenbank Giro) is recorded as a regular income and the advisor asks at most ONE next question for the plan (for example the fixed costs). It does not repeat the income question and does not mention an internal agent.

name: S7 Owner gruesst bei offenem Haushalt: ein Satz mit Haushalt-Vorschlag, kein Marker, kein Guide

turns.expected_behavior: The reply is the orchestrator's own (the guide agent is NOT called): one short German sentence (with the greeting) that suggests setting up the household, without a question and without a list of topics. The visible text has no NEXT_STEP line. Judge ONLY the agent's own text: the 'Weiter: <area>' button under the reply is built by the system from the marker line the router writes and strips before sending, so it does not count as a NEXT_STEP line or as a second sentence.

name: S8 Mitglied gruesst bei offenem Haushalt: der Owner richtet noch ein, keine Markerzeile

turns.expected_behavior: The reply is the orchestrator's own, short and in German (a greeting plus one sentence): it says in plain words that whoever runs the household (wording such as 'Haushaltsinhaber' or 'Owner' is equally fine) is still setting things up and that the assistant can help afterwards. No NEXT_STEP line, no topic list, no button, no question to the member.

name: S9 Nach dem Veroeffentlichen: Liste genau einmal, Durchgehen schliesst jede Vormerkung, Bank-Liste einmal gebuendelt am Ende
notes: Die Schalter plan_rollout und remind_bank_todo sind im Test-Substrat ab Installation aus (Zeitgeber-Sperre); der Fall schaltet sie fuer seine Dauer ein, das teardown_sql wieder aus. Vorzustand wie live: die Liste wurde mitten im Gespraech gezeigt und gemerkt (core.fn_handoff_overview_mark unter Version 1), danach veroeffentlicht (Version 2). Runde 1: die Abfolge am Laufende schickt die Liste. Runde 2: [Durchgehen]; der Buchhalter (Mock) aendert einen Dauerauftrag (tool_set_recurring_payment) und legt fuer eine zweite Vormerkung zwei jaehrliche Uebertraege an, drei Karten angenommen; am Laufende kommt die Bank-Liste als eine Nachricht. DB-Gesetze: test_fn_plan_rollout_next, test_fn_with_handoff, test_fn_plan_rollout.
setup_sql: UPDATE core.config SET value = 'true' WHERE category = 'cron_enable' AND key IN ('plan_rollout', 'remind_bank_todo'); DELETE FROM agent.handoff_tasks WHERE domain = 'finance'; DELETE FROM core.notification_state WHERE source = 'plan_rollout' AND key LIKE 'finance:%'; INSERT INTO finance.accounts (name, account_type, currency, status, bank, owner_person_id) VALUES ('__E2E__ FD Giro', 'cash', 'EUR', 'active', '__E2E__ Testbank', 'owner'), ('__E2E__ FD Tagesgeld', 'cash', 'EUR', 'active', '__E2E__ Testbank', 'owner'), ('__E2E__ FD Topf', 'cash', 'EUR', 'active', '__E2E__ Testbank', 'owner'); SELECT pg_temp.ok('uebertrag', finance.fn_create_recurring_transfer(jsonb_build_object('name', '__E2E__ FD Uebertrag', 'from_account_id', (SELECT id FROM finance.accounts WHERE name = '__E2E__ FD Giro'), 'to_account_id', (SELECT id FROM finance.accounts WHERE name = '__E2E__ FD Tagesgeld'), 'amount', 200, 'schedule_unit', 'month', 'schedule_day_of_month', 20, 'first_payment_date', (current_date + 40)::text))); INSERT INTO agent.advisor_plans (domain, plan_name, status, version, synced_at, plan_md) VALUES ('finance', '__E2E__ FD Plan', 'active', 1, now(), 'x'); INSERT INTO agent.handoff_tasks (id, domain, package, person_id, section_key, kind, text) VALUES (990031, 'finance', 'finance', 'owner', 'wealth_building', 'recurring_transfer', '__E2E__ FD Uebertrag kuenftig am 1.'), (990032, 'finance', 'finance', 'owner', 'goals_triggers', 'recurring_transfer', '__E2E__ FD Zwei Uebertraege im Jahr in den Topf'); SELECT core.fn_handoff_overview_mark(jsonb_build_object('domain', 'finance', 'chat_id', '0', 'max_task_id', '990032')); UPDATE agent.advisor_plans SET status = 'superseded' WHERE plan_name = '__E2E__ FD Plan' AND version = 1; INSERT INTO agent.advisor_plans (domain, plan_name, status, version, synced_at, plan_md) VALUES ('finance', '__E2E__ FD Plan', 'active', 2, now(), 'x');
precondition_sql: (SELECT count(*) FROM core.notification_state WHERE source = 'plan_rollout' AND key LIKE 'finance:household:%handoff:990032' AND state = 'fired') = 1
teardown_sql: UPDATE core.config SET value = 'false' WHERE category = 'cron_enable' AND key IN ('plan_rollout', 'remind_bank_todo'); DELETE FROM agent.handoff_tasks WHERE id IN (990031, 990032); DELETE FROM agent.advisor_plans WHERE plan_name = '__E2E__ FD Plan'; DELETE FROM core.notification_state WHERE (source = 'plan_rollout' AND key LIKE 'finance:%') OR (source = 'finance:bank_todo' AND key ~ ':r[0-9]+:');

SELECT count(*) FROM finance.bank_todos WHERE handoff_task_id IN (990031, 990032) AND first_sent_at IS NOT NULL;

name: S20 Eintrag pruefen: erledigter Altbestand ohne Soll geht einmal an den Berater, eine Korrektur kommt als neue Vormerkung auf die Liste
notes: Vorzustand wie nach einem Update: eine vor der Provenienz erledigte Vormerkung (close_reason leer), deren Abschnitt im gueltigen Plan steht. Runde 1: die Abfolge am Laufende bietet den Pruef-Schritt an (Merker ohne Version). Runde 2: [Jetzt pruefen] -> Berater (Mock) im Auftrag Eintrag pruefen legt per tool_record_handoff_correction eine neue Vormerkung mit follows_task_id an (Karte angenommen); am Laufende kommt die Liste mit dem neuen Eintrag. DB-Gesetze: test_fn_plan_rollout_next (Block check), test_fn_handle_plan_cb (plan:check), test_fn_record_handoff_correction.
setup_sql: UPDATE core.config SET value = 'true' WHERE category = 'cron_enable' AND key = 'plan_rollout'; DELETE FROM agent.handoff_tasks WHERE domain = 'finance'; DELETE FROM core.notification_state WHERE source = 'plan_rollout' AND key LIKE 'finance:%'; INSERT INTO agent.advisor_plans (domain, plan_name, status, version, synced_at, plan_md, interview_state) VALUES ('finance', '__E2E__ EP Plan', 'active', 1, now(), 'x', jsonb_build_object('wealth_building', jsonb_build_object('content', 'x'))); INSERT INTO agent.handoff_tasks (id, domain, package, person_id, section_key, kind, text, status, closed_at) VALUES (990061, 'finance', 'finance', 'owner', 'wealth_building', 'other', '__E2E__ EP Alter Eintrag Sparrate 100', 'done', now());
precondition_sql: (SELECT count(*) FROM agent.handoff_tasks WHERE id = 990061 AND status = 'done' AND close_reason IS NULL) = 1 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM agent.advisor_plans WHERE plan_name = '__E2E__ EP Plan' AND status = 'active' AND interview_state ? 'wealth_building') = 1
teardown_sql: UPDATE core.config SET value = 'false' WHERE category = 'cron_enable' AND key = 'plan_rollout'; DELETE FROM agent.handoff_tasks WHERE id = 990061 OR follows_task_id = 990061; DELETE FROM agent.advisor_plans WHERE plan_name = '__E2E__ EP Plan'; DELETE FROM core.notification_state WHERE (source = 'plan_rollout' AND key LIKE 'finance:%') OR (source IN ('plan_verb', 'plan_verb_day'));
